title: DonutSMP Ultimate Modpack
description: This is a DonutSMP optimized modpack designed to keep everything vanilla. Now with the Chaos Cubed update!
body:
##

About

This is a community made modpack that is optimized specifically for DonutSMP! It gives you all the best mods for any situation, while keeping the game Vanilla! It includes mods like Iris + Sodium for shaders, Litematica for building farms, and Auto Reconnect Reforged for afking your farms! This modpack includes many more popular and helpful mods for everything you do on DonutSMP!



Join my discord server for daily DonutSMP giveaways and more! Copy an paste this link in your browser to join!
https://discord.gg/V7ctT5M3Yd

Full Mod List - AppleSkin - Auto Reconnect Reforged - Cloth Config API - Collective - Complementary Shaders - Reimagined - Continuity - Crosshair Addons Public - Enchantment Descriptions - Essential Mod - Fabric API - FerriteCore - Freelook - Iris Shaders - Litematica - Lithium - Low Fire - MaLiLib - Minimal Status Effect Timer - Mod Menu - ModListMemory - More Chat History - Prickle - Puzzle - Screencopy - Shulker Box Tooltip - Simple Durability Tooltip - Simple Voice Chat - Sodium - Text Placeholder API - uku's Armor HUD - ukulib - WalksyLib - YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)
